What FinSight Does For You

📊

Revenue Tracking

Track every transaction, see revenue growth over time, and understand where your money comes from.

💰

Expense Analysis

Break down expenses by category, identify fixed vs variable costs, and find where you can cut spending.

📈

Profit Margins

Calculate gross and net profit margins automatically and track how your profitability changes month to month.

🔮

AI Forecasting

Get revenue, expense, and profit forecasts based on your historical data with confidence ranges.

💬

Ask Your Finances

Ask questions like "How is my business doing?" and get conversational AI-powered answers based on your real data.

📋

Monthly Reports

Generate detailed monthly summaries with cash flow, profit margins, expense ratios, and growth trends.

Built For Small Businesses In South Africa

FinSight was built by a team of developers who understand that most small business owners don't have time to sit with spreadsheets or hire accountants. We built an AI that does the heavy lifting so you can focus on growing your business.
